author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-29 chains ('Ah can you go and do this now'), The Rounds in chains.md; written 2026-11-10 on OT-30 and OT-9A
_note: THE ROUNDS, LINK 2 of 2 (finale). Spec: home-office office/projects/delves/chains.md; medic family.
THE PLAYER'S PART: finding him. The note on his door says where he went and when, and the date is the alarm. Then a med pack (a wounded talk, OT-9A).
CAUSE (rule 2): Rosa asked, because nobody has heard from him in days. Chain-only, so it may remember her (rule 3), but no voiced line names her (no names aloud).
SHAPE (rule 1): link 1 was pickup then talk; this is use (read the door) then a wounded talk.
Register: the warm common job, and a small fright. Pay: med, more than link 1's easy (rule 6).

place._theme: A quiet worked site, his. The board's own request, a new site (every link has a site of its own: place.inherit retired 2026-11-09, his 'If we need it always to run it should be using remote sites and making gaurnteed stuff').

prose.name: Hauling: The Old Miner on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A patient of the settlement medic asked me to look in on an old miner at the <Place>. Nobody has heard from him in days.

speaker.name: Settlement Medic
speaker._name: MB86a's speaker: the same person on the radio, which is the point of a chain.

broadcast: She told me you're looking in on him. He won't have asked for anyone. Take a med pack, he'll say he doesn't need it.

beats._model: A note or a slate on a door if one fits; the terminal is the stand-in.
beats.name: Note on the Door
beats.objective: Look in on the old miner at the <Place>

message.title: Note on the Door
message.text:
Gone down the dig. Back by dark.

The date on it is four days old.

beats.journal: His note says he went down his dig, back by dark. It's four days old. I need to find him.

person.name: Tobin Ferris
hellos: Who's that? If you're selling, I can't get up to say no.

_bio.from: a miner who still works his own dig alone (his lines, the note)
_bio.why_there: fell in his own dig four days ago (his lines)
_bio.wants: to not have needed anyone, and to walk over and say so himself (his lines)

greeting: Fell in my own dig. Four days I've been telling myself I'll get up in a minute. She sent you, didn't she.

reply: That's the leg back. I'll walk over on Sunday and tell her myself. She'll like that better than hearing it from you.

exchanges.prompt: Why didn't you call for help?
reply: Pride, mostly. And the radio's in the house, and I'm not.

beats.journal: A patient of the medic's sent me to look in on an old miner at the <Place>. He'd been down his own dig for four days. I patched him up.
